splash_tagline: From the farm, straight to you
language_change_later: You can change this anytime from your profile.
onboarding_1_title: Fresh produce, straight from the farm
onboarding_1_body: Buy directly from farmers near you. See who grew it, when it was harvested, and pay a fair price with no middlemen.
onboarding_2_body: Farmers list a fresh batch in under a minute, set their own price, and get paid straight to their wallet.
onboarding_3_body: Drivers pick up along routes they already travel and earn on every trip, while buyers track each order live.
